features.title: Locations Reference Table & Service-Area Autocomplete Picker
features.description: Replace free-text serving_cities/serving_zipcodes arrays on contractor profiles with a normalized projects.locations reference table covering states, metros (CBSAs), counties, cities, and zip codes for the United States. Contractors pick service areas from an autocomplete and the system stores location UUIDs; matching expands a chosen state/metro/county/city to its underlying zip set so a contractor who selects 'San Francisco-Oakland-Berkeley, CA' sees jobs in Danville, Oakland, Palo Alto, etc. without typing each one. Ships a curated US seed dataset (states + top metros + top cities + representative zips) loaded automatically on first server boot via runMigrations — idempotent so subsequent boots are no-ops. Keeps serving_cities[] / serving_zipcodes[] populated in parallel during rollout for backward compatibility, and includes a one-time backfill that maps existing free-text city strings to best-match location rows so existing contractors don't need to re-onboard. Resolves the 'Sara can't see Danville Kitchen Remodeling because she put Bay Area in serving_cities' class of bug.
